CONTEXT_CLASSIFICATION.context_at_time_of_insight: Architecting the CompanySiteApply enterprise ATS application subsystem as an isolated, multi-fingered extensible arm to handle Workday, Oracle Cloud HCM, Greenhouse, Lever, etc.

CONTEXT_TRANSITION.previous_context: Portal-level automation on Naukri & LinkedIn and Sophron cognitive synchronization
CONTEXT_TRANSITION.trigger_for_switch: User initiated expansion into direct company website / ATS applications with live Oracle Cloud HCM session open on CDP
CONTEXT_TRANSITION.new_context: Design and implementation plan for CompanySiteApply subsystem with page-by-page manual inspection, resume parser anomaly healing, and 100-day extensible finger architecture

psychological_state.decision_style: Rigorous empirical reverse-engineering. Demands manual page-by-page inspection, active live browser testing, honeypot detection, parser anomaly fixing, and pristine architectural isolation from core/

interaction_pairing.user_action: Requested deep architectural plan for company career site apply agent, emphasizing isolated CompanySiteApply folder, multi-fingered ATS detection, manual trigger mode, resume parser healing (line breaks & college data), and live inspection of open Oracle Cloud tab.
interaction_pairing.ai_response_quality: Conducting deep research, inspecting live Oracle Cloud DOM on CDP port 9222, identifying honeypot traps, syncing Sophron, and formulating exhaustive Implementation Plan.
interaction_pairing.friction_points: None. The vision is clear: enterprise ATSs have distinct quirks (Workday line breaks, Oracle JET honeypots), requiring modular finger plugins rather than monolithic scripts.
interaction_pairing.resolution: Isolated CompanySiteApply subsystem with modular fingers, live inspection mode, parser healing doctor, and comprehensive 100-day edit documentation.

cognitive_evolution.new_pattern_detected: User conceptualizes complex automation as an anatomical arm with distinct fingers for each platform/parser. Emphasizes long-term maintenance (the 100-day rule) ensuring any developer or AI can pick up and add a new site without architectural debt.
cognitive_evolution.changed_from_prior_belief: Direct company applications cannot be treated as a single uniform scraper; ATS diversity requires decoupled platform-specific fingers with common dispatch and parser-healing layers.
cognitive_evolution.consistency_with_axioms: Directly demonstrates Axiom 1 (runtime reality over assumptions), Axiom 2 (generic, parameter-driven architecture), Axiom 3 (microscopic DOM reverse-engineering), and Axiom 4 (analytical investigator reporting to principal authority).

long_term_application.future_implication: CompanySiteApply lives strictly in CompanySiteApply/ decoupled from core/. Scripts are triggered on-demand, never running as an uncontrolled background daemon. All ATS quirks (honeypots, soft wraps, custom selects) are documented in platform finger cards.
long_term_application.cross_project_note: The multi-finger plugin pattern with contract-enforced adapters is applicable across all external integration projects.
